why: Ends the translation unit this function belongs to. The sweep's gap-prologue pass gave it 0x0003B940, nine bytes past the boundary, which is not a place a function can end: an external delinking analysis puts the object's last byte at 0x0003B937. Verified independently by auditing every function in the database against that map -- this was the only one of 10,292 that crossed an object boundary.
